 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Santosh Anand - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Shanti Tiwari - P.L for the respondent/State.
Also heard on IA No.32181/2024, which is the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of applicant.

The applicant has been convicted by the trial Court under Sections 7(1) r/w 16(1)(A)(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo RI for one year with fine of Rs.2000/-with default stipulations.
Aforesaid conviction and sentence has been affirmed by the Appellate Court.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the Courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the applicant for aforesaid offence.
There is a bleak possibility of disposal of this revision in near future, therefore, the sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and period of sentence awarded to the applicant,
I find it to be a fit case to suspend the jail 2 CRR-6167-2024 sentence of the applicant and to release him on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing of the fine amount and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the remaining sentence of applicant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 03.03.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this case.
